carousel.author: Rob
carousel.text: Jeremy was able to give me a quote over the phone which was very helpful! His quote was very reasonably priced.

carousel.author: Nancy S.
carousel.text: So lucky to get a referral to Croff Electric for rewiring my 100 year old house in a historic neighborhood. This team of father, sons, and dad works like a well oiled machine…

carousel.author: Coco M.
carousel.text: Replied within 24 hours, explained the process and how long it will take to finish the installation…

carousel.author: Robert A.
carousel.text: They installed a hardwired EV charger for my home and completed conduit prep work for a future solar installation. The work was clean, professional…

carousel.author: Cole I.
carousel.text: Jeremy and team were great to work with! They were prompt, responsive, and gave a very reasonable quote for the work.

carousel.author: Ben W.
carousel.text: I've used Croff Electric several times over the years, at multiple commercial buildings I manage. Their work is professional and their prices are fair.

tool_idea.name: EV Charger & Panel Readiness Planner
tool_idea.desc: The user picks a charger level (Level 2 at 32/40/48A), panel size (100/125/200A), home age, the main loads they already have (AC, electric range, dryer, spa) and the distance from panel to parking spot. The tool estimates the breaker size, wire gauge, and whether a load calc or panel upgrade is likely. It flags permit and SCE Charge Ready Home eligibility, then sends the summary to the estimate form. The demo shouldn't show prices, since Croff publishes none. Show complexity tiers and say 'free estimate'.
tool_idea.why: His best recent reviews are EV charger, panel and rewire jobs, and he's on SCE's Charge Ready Home list. Note: a static 'EV charger planner' demo already exists in lead-demo-templates/2026-09-28/croff-electric, which this build should supersede.

chatbot_training_notes: Use only the facts above. Don't state prices or emergency service. For quotes, collect name, phone, address/ZIP, job type and photos, then send them to (310) 406-6909 or the form.
